exposure: History of PGP the year before pregnancy
outcome: Subjective recovery from pregnancy-related pelvic girdle pain (PGP)
cohort: 130 women who reported pregnancy-related pelvic girdle pain (PGP) during pregnancy and met for clinical examination 6 weeks after delivery.
finding: The majority of women (83%) experienced substantial subjective recovery from severe or moderate PGP within 6 weeks after delivery, with multiparity, PGP the year before pregnancy, and high pain intensity during pregnancy identified as predictors for poor recovery.
